name: Standard array
description: Assign 15, 14, 13, 12, 10 and 8 to the six abilities, one value each.

name: Point buy
description: Spend up to 27 points. Every ability starts at 8 and can be raised to 15 before racial bonuses.

name: Roll
description: Roll 4d6 six times, dropping the lowest die each time, then assign the totals to the abilities.
